title: Canadian Intern Arrested on Espionage Charges at NATO's SHAPE Headquarters
detail: Belgian federal prosecutors arrested a Canadian woman of Chinese origin — later identified in reporting as systems engineer Biwei Zhang, a former Canadian Space Agency and Statistics Canada contractor — at NATO's Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) in Mons, Belgium, on July 25, 2026. She is suspected of spying on behalf of a third, undisclosed country and of membership in a criminal organization. Belgian authorities searched her home and workplace. A SHAPE spokesperson said there is no indication NATO operational readiness, command-and-control arrangements, or ongoing tasks have been affected, but the arrest raises fresh counterintelligence concerns at the alliance's operational nerve center just as burden-sharing and reliability questions dominate the transatlantic relationship.

media.caption: Canadian intern at NATO HQ in Belgium arrested on suspicion of spying for 'third country'
